claims.claim: Added one AIOS_REVIEWER_PROCEDURE_PROFILES v1 registry with the reviewer-semantic-v1 profile, canonical SEMANTIC_REVIEW metadata, exact v1 bounds, and ordered PRIMARY and DELTA steps. The registry contains the procedure prose.

The registry states PRIMARY coverage, inspection, cross-check, defect sweep, and closure rules; DELTA prior-finding and correction rules; the semantic BLOCKED boundary; and one-call invocation constraints.

The pure parser and selector enforce the closed v1 structure, ordering, UTF-8 and size bounds, authoritative mode token, and a SHA-256 reference over canonical JSON of the full normalized profile and effective bounds.
The production change is limited to the procedure registry and pure procedure module; it adds no repository or provider I/O, REVIEW handling, lifecycle mutation, retry, or persistent semantic state.
